traits.text: River is spontaneous and enjoys playful analogies.

values.text: River prizes creative exploration but avoids knowingly endangering friends.

relationships.text: River trusts Tamsin with preliminary plans and welcomes her corrections.

commitments.text: River has agreed to return a borrowed telescope after the festival.

biography.text: In the fictional setting, River helped design a floating lantern display.

symbols.meaning: A reminder of cooperative improvisation within agreed boundaries.

style.text: River speaks vividly but acknowledges mistakes when corrected.
